description: Top-level index for the JSP/1 compliance framework (issue 477). Enumerates machine-readable schemas, the 15 reference scenarios, and the producer/server adapter traces. External implementations consume these artifacts and the Rust reference reducer/profiles validate them. Current-state JSP/1 semantics apply: no replay/history/resume/resync; gaps, reconnects, and epoch changes require a fresh snapshot-first stream.
